It will then execute a comprehensive walkthrough of the 6-step quote wizard, testing complex interactions like the breed combobox, condition chips, and tier comparison logic. Finally, it will validate the Claims form and FAQ accordion before repeating critical path checks on a mobile viewport to address known tap-target risks.
